subject: Recompose this image as an extreme close-up: zoom into the most dramatically expressive detail of the primary subject — the eyes, a specific facial feature, a hand, or a key object — and fill the entire frame with this detail. Apply a shallow depth of field appropriate to an extreme macro or very long lens close-up perspective, with surrounding areas softly out of focus. Render fine surface texture and micro-detail with high fidelity. The composition should be tight, tense, and cinematically intentional.
